settings.promptManager.title: Instructions and roles
settings.promptManager.description: The sections are now separate: roles define the agent's primary behavior, while instructions and presets assemble extra rules.
settings.promptManager.instructionsDescr: Assemble the active set of extra rules without accidentally changing the agent role or preset.
settings.promptManager.presetsPageDescri: Save and apply reusable combinations of a role and instructions on a separate page.
settings.promptManager.rolesDescription: A role is the agent's primary system behavior. Choose the active role here and edit the role library.
settings.promptManager.autosaveHint: Card edits are saved with Save. Active role, instruction, or preset selection is applied separately with Apply, so an accidental click does not change the next request.
settings.promptManager.mode.global.title: Global roles
settings.promptManager.mode.local.title: Project roles
settings.promptManager.instruction.descr: Reusable system instructions. Enable any subset in the "What the agent receives now" block.
settings.promptManager.mode.description: A role is one primary behavior instruction, such as Coder or Architect.
settings.promptManager.empty: No items yet. Add one or copy an existing item to customize it.
settings.promptManager.activeDescription: Choose one role and extra instructions. The set changes only after you press Apply.
settings.promptManager.activeRoleDescrip: Role selection is separate from editing text: review the markdown preview first, then apply the role for the next requests.
settings.promptManager.presetsDescriptio: A preset is a selected role plus a set of instructions. Applying a preset changes the active set immediately and explicitly.
settings.promptManager.noPresets: No presets yet. Add the first preset to combine a mode and instructions.
settings.promptManager.presetEditorDescr: Name the preset, choose an agent role, and select instructions. Saving a preset does not apply it automatically.
settings.promptManager.activePresetDescr: Choose a saved preset and apply it explicitly to the next requests.
settings.promptManager.helpDescription: Small guide for roles, instructions, and presets.
settings.promptManager.helpInstructions: are reusable rules. Add as many as you want, then enable only the ones needed for the current project.
settings.promptManager.helpModes: are the primary role instruction, for example Coder or Architect. You can use a role even when no extra instructions are enabled.
settings.promptManager.helpPresets: save a selected set of instructions plus one role. Use them to switch quickly between setups like Coding, Design, Review, or Testing.
settings.promptManager.helpStorage: Global items are stored in your home folder. Project items are stored in .aist-agent and override global priorities.
settings.memory.title: Memory
settings.memory.description: User-approved notes from approval prompts. Disabled notes stay stored but are not sent to the model.
settings.memory.inboxDescription: Suggestions from the last agent runs. Save only the ones you want AIST to reuse.
settings.skills.title: Custom skills
settings.skills.description: Add Bash-backed skills the agent can call with run_skill. Input is passed via stdin and AIST_SKILL_INPUT.
settings.skills.descriptionPlaceholder: When should the agent use this skill?

settings.permissions.presetsDescription: Quickly switch the current tool access profile for the AI agent.
settings.providers.title: Provider profiles
settings.providers.description: Configure endpoint and proxy for each provider separately.
settings.providers.productHint: A profile describes the network route to a provider. By default AIST calls the standard endpoint directly; corporate proxy settings can be added only to the provider copies that need them.
settings.providers.codexDescription: ChatGPT Codex Responses API and Codex authorization.
settings.providers.endpointHint: Keep the standard value for direct provider requests or set your corporate endpoint.
settings.providers.proxyHostHint: When set, AIST sends the request to the proxy host and passes the original endpoint in the endpoint query parameter.
settings.providers.apiKeyHint: Saved as a global secret for this profile only. AIST never writes it to workspace settings.
settings.providers.apiKeyUnsupportedHint: This provider uses a different authorization flow.
settings.compaction.title: Context compaction
settings.compaction.description: When context becomes too large, AIST can start a fresh chat linked to the previous one. Old messages stay visible but stop being sent to the model.
settings.compaction.keepLast: Keep last messages in new context
settings.compaction.keepLastHint: 0 means old context is fully cut off after the compaction line.
settings.system.languageDescription: Controls agent answers, tool-call explanations, and extension UI language.
settings.system.iterationDescription: Maximum model/tool-call turns per request. Set to 0 to run without a limit.
settings.system.composerDescription: Controls the compact input field while the agent keeps working in the background.
settings.system.composerMinimizeOnBlurDe: When the agent is working and the AIST window is not focused, Composer collapses into a compact strip.
settings.system.composerGradientWhileBus: Animate the minimized strip with theme colors while the agent is running.
settings.system.codexDescriptionAuthoriz: Authorization is active. Codex models are available.
settings.system.codexDescriptionUnauthor: Authorize ChatGPT Codex to use codex:* models.

settings.auxiliary.compactionModelHint: Empty means use the active chat model. Set a lightweight model for cheaper summaries.
settings.auxiliary.allowToolsHint: Compaction usually does not need tools; enable only when the summary must read the project.
settings.auxiliary.toolDescription: When a model is set, the agent gets the invoke_model tool and can delegate short subtasks to a lightweight model.
settings.auxiliary.toolModelHint: Empty hides invoke_model. Set a fast model for simple answers.
settings.auxiliary.toolAllowToolsHint: For safety invoke_model currently returns a plain answer without nested tool calls; the option is stored for settings compatibility.
settings.auxiliary.toolOverridesDescript: Override the default model for a specific tool. For example, invoke_model can use codex:spark while compaction uses OpenRouter Gemini.
